eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 5:07 PM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 10:07 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Missing Person Alert

The Flagstaff Police Department is seeking assistance in locating a missing adult female. Connie Platero is approximately 5 feet tall and weighs around 140 pounds. She was last seen near the 1000 block of North Fourth Street, wearing a blue shirt and blue pants. She has white hair styled in braids, uses a cane for mobility, and is known to have cognitive impairment.

If you have any information regarding her whereabouts, please contact the Flagstaff Police Department at 928-774-1414 or dial 911.
